AgentModelState.description: Effective model state for one catalog agent.

OauthTokens.description: OAuth tokens captured from a completed provider flow.

ProviderSummary.description: One provider route with aggregate auth state.

ProviderInfo.description: Provider detail with its model rows.

Error.description: Stable, machine-readable error returned by every failed v1 call.  HTTP bindings render `{"error": {"code": ..., "message": ...}}` with the status mapped from the code; gRPC bindings carry the same code in the trailer/status details.

PageRequest.description: Standard list controls shared by every paginated rpc.

PageInfo.description: Pagination outcome attached to every paginated response.

StreamFrame.description: One frame on a live stream.

ResyncFrame.description: Typed lag signal replacing the legacy SSE `resync` event name.

StreamEvent.description: One curated projected event from the event log.

MessageStarted.description: A session was deleted. A message started.

MessageFinished.description: A message reached a terminal state.

PartStarted.description: A part was appended to a message.

PartAppended.description: Streaming delta appended to a part.

PartCompleted.description: A part reached its final form.

ToolStateChanged.description: A tool call's execution state changed.

TokensRecorded.description: Token usage was recorded for a round.

CompactionApplied.description: A compaction strategy was applied to the context.

CommandTransport.description: stdio transport: launch a local command.

UrlTransport.description: HTTP/SSE transport: connect to a URL.

TokenUsage.description: Token accounting for one model round.

ToolCallPart.description: A tool invocation requested by the model.

ToolResultPart.description: The outcome of a tool invocation.

AttachmentPart.description: A binary or file attachment on a message.

PartInfo.description: One part of a message body.

TodoItem.description: One todo item of a session's plan.

LocationInfo.description: Where this backend runs and which directory it serves.

PtySession.description: State snapshot of one PTY session.

PtyAttach.description: Session attachment envelope for the gRPC terminal stream.

SessionRef.description: Session id string (`hysec_...`, `ses_...`, or legacy raw UUID accepted on input; canonical form on output).

ShellTurn.description: A synthetic shell turn: the command runs via the builtin shell tool with no model round.

TurnInfo.description: Projection snapshot of one admitted turn. The turn id is the id of the assistant message the engine drives for that turn.

WorkflowStageRun.description: Execution state of one stage member.

WorkflowState.description: Projected workflow state of a session.

WorkflowInfoCommand.description: `list` command: enumerate workflow sources. `info` command: inspect one compiled workflow.

WorkflowRunCommand.description: `run` command: start the selected or named workflow.

WorkflowModelAssignment.description: Authored worker model assignment for a stage.

WorkflowStageInfo.description: Compiled stage metadata from the `info` result.

AgentModelSource.description: Which tier resolved an agent's effective base model.

AuthStatus.description: Authentication state of a provider route.

RulePermission.description: Effect of a saved permission rule.

LogLevel.description: Severity of an ingested log entry.

McpServerState.description: Connection state of an MCP server.

FinishReason.description: Terminal reason of an assistant message.

ToolExecutionState.description: Execution state of one tool call.

TodoStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a todo item.

WorkflowRunStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a workflow run.
